description: Charge and pI of AcrIE3 (A0SMP0) and the formal charge of the PAM-duplex contact sets found independently in each Cas8e
code:
import os, json, time, requests, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT=os.getcwd()

def fasta(acc):
    r=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta", timeout=30)
    if r.status_code!=200: return None
    L=r.text.strip().split("\n"); return L[0], "".join(L[1:])

accs={"A0SMP0 (DMS3-30 / AcrIE3)":"A0SMP0"}
out={}
for lab,a in accs.items():
    f=fasta(a)
    if f: out[lab]=f; print(lab, "len", len(f[1])); print("  ", f[0]); print("  ", f[1])
    time.sleep(0.3)

seq=out["A0SMP0 (DMS3-30 / AcrIE3)"][1]
pos=sum(c in "KR" for c in seq); neg=sum(c in "DE" for c in seq); his=seq.count("H")
print(f"\nAcrIE3 (A0SMP0): {len(seq)} aa, K+R={pos}, D+E={neg}, net formal charge at pH 7 = {pos-neg:+d}")
print(f"acidic fraction {neg/len(seq)*100:.1f}%, basic fraction {pos/len(seq)*100:.1f}%")

# Bjellqvist-style pI by bisection on the standard Henderson-Hasselbalch charge curve
pK={'Cterm':3.55,'D':4.05,'E':4.45,'C':9.0,'Y':10.0,'H':5.98,'Nterm':7.5,'K':10.0,'R':12.0}
def charge(s,pH):
    q = 1/(1+10**(pH-pK['Nterm'])) - 1/(1+10**(pK['Cterm']-pH))
    for aa in "KRH": q += s.count(aa)/(1+10**(pH-pK[aa]))
    for aa in "DECY": q -= s.count(aa)/(1+10**(pK[aa]-pH))
    return q
lo,hi=2.0,12.0
for _ in range(60):
    mid=(lo+hi)/2
    if charge(seq,mid)>0: lo=mid
    else: hi=mid
pI=(lo+hi)/2
print(f"computed isoelectric point of AcrIE3 = {pI:.2f}; net charge at pH 7.0 = {charge(seq,7.0):+.1f}")

# compare with the two Cas8e PAM patches already computed
patch=json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT,"pam_patch_charge.json")))
print("\nPAM patch formal charge by shell (from pam_patch_charge.json):")
print(patch)

# Background: pI distribution of the P. aeruginosa Cas8e reference and E. coli Cse1
seqs=json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT,"cas8e_sequences.json")))
ec=seqs["ec_q46901"]
pa=[it["seq"] for it in seqs["groups"]["P_aeruginosa"] if "A0A3S4PYN6" in it["header"] or "WP_057392414" in it["header"]][0]
def getpI(s):
    lo,hi=2.0,12.0
    for _ in range(60):
        m=(lo+hi)/2
        if charge(s,m)>0: lo=m
        else: hi=m
    return (lo+hi)/2
print(f"\nwhole-protein pI: E. coli Cse1 {getpI(ec):.2f}, P. aeruginosa Cas8e {getpI(pa):.2f}, AcrIE3 {pI:.2f}")

# Figure: reciprocal PAM contacts, charge of each residue
rp=json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT,"reciprocal_pam_contacts.json")))
ecc=rp["ec_crystal"]; pac=rp["pa_local"]
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.4),sharey=True)
def q(c): return 1 if c in "KR" else -1 if c in "DE" else 0
for ax,(items,lab) in zip(axes,[([ (n,a,None) for n,a in ecc],
    "E. coli K-12 Cse1, crystal (PDB 5H9F)"), (pac,"P. aeruginosa Cas8e, local superposition")]):
    labs=[f"{a}{n}" for n,a,*rest in items]; vals=[q(a) for n,a,*rest in items]
    col=["#2c6fbb" if v>0 else "#c0392b" if v<0 else "#9aa5b1" for v in vals]
    ax.bar(range(len(vals)),vals,color=col,edgecolor="k",lw=0.4)
    ax.set_xticks(range(len(vals))); ax.set_xticklabels(labs,rotation=90,fontsize=8)
    ax.axhline(0,color="k",lw=0.8); ax.set_title(f"{lab}\nnet formal charge {sum(vals):+d}",fontsize=10)
axes[0].set_ylabel("formal charge at pH 7"); axes[0].set_ylim(-1.4,1.4)
fig.suptitle("Residues within 4 A of the PAM duplex, found independently in each protein\n"
             "AcrIE3 (A0SMP0) carries net charge "+f"{charge(seq,7.0):+.1f}"+" at pH 7, pI "+f"{pI:.2f}",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
json.dump({"acrIE3_len":len(seq),"acrIE3_pos":pos,"acrIE3_neg":neg,"acrIE3_pI":round(pI,2),
           "acrIE3_q7":round(float(charge(seq,7.0)),2),"ec_pI":round(getpI(ec),2),
           "pa_pI":round(getpI(pa),2)}, open(os.path.join(OUT,"acrie3_charge.json"),"w"))
